summary: Repaired consumer.py on node1. It now accepts successive FIFO producers, records only complete non-empty lines, blocks without spinning between producers, preserves existing records, and shuts down cleanly on SIGTERM. The repair persisted through the required node reboot; RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, SELinux enforcement, permissions, and administrative access remain intact.
